title: IF...ELSE Statement (Multiple Conditions)

lines.explanation: Assigning the value 20 to the variable 'temperature'
This statement checks if the condition (temperature is less than 0) is true. The value of temperature is 20 so this statement is not true.
In case if the above if statement was true, it would execute this statement and print out the following string.

'elif' is a short for 'Else If'. This code jumps to this condition if the above 'if' condition was not true. This statement checks if the condition (temperature is more than or equal to 0 but less than 20) is true or not. The value of temperature is 20 so this statement is not true.
Since the above 'elif' condition was false, this print statement will not be executed

Since the above 'elif' statement was not true, the code jumps to this condition. This statement checks if the condition (temperature is more than or equal to 20 and less than 30) is true or not. The value of temperature is 20 so this statement is true.
Since the above 'elif' statement is true, this print statement will be executed and it will print out the string 'It is just about fine'
The above statement was true so it will not jump to 'else' statement. But just imagine if all the above conditions were not true then this 'else' statement would be executed
